description: This MATLAB script visualizes results from battery degradation simulations, including plotting battery states, OCV curves, voltage during check-up cycles, pulse charge voltage, and cycling data, based on CSV files generated by a C++ function 'ProfileAgeing'.

methods.name: printDEGID
methods.description: Generates a degradation ID string based on model parameters.

methods.name: readAgeing_BatteryState
methods.description: Plots battery capacity and degradation details from CSV data.

methods.name: readAgeing_OCV
methods.description: Plots OCV curves from CSV data.

methods.name: readAgeing_CCCV
methods.description: Plots voltage during CCCV check-up cycles from CSV data.

methods.name: readAgeing_pulse
methods.description: Plots voltage during pulse charge from CSV data.

methods.name: readAgeing_cyclingData
methods.description: Plots cycling data including current, voltage, and temperature from CSV data.
